GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 352 (11 Dec 45) ESS-ST
(SCAPIN - 420)
APO 500
11 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Utilization of the Central Aeronautical Research Institute
1. In accordance with CLO No. 835 (32) of 2 December 1945, it is directed that the provisions of General Headquarters directive AG 360 (18 Nov 45)ESS-E, dtd 18 Nov 45 (subj: Commercial and Civil Aviation), shall apply in all respects and the institute is to be disbanded by 31 December 1945.
2. The request to convert the institute facilities to civilian use is not approved.
3. Acknowledgement of this memorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
